setup.skills_note: skills_read = published app skills the agent opened in that task. skill_assisted = the subset with a rule written for an action or reading this task needs (our reading of each skill text); opening a skill whose rules do not apply to the task is not counted as assisted.

task.goal: Create a note in Markor named copy_bold_pig.txt. Perform a paste operation in the note and save the note.
task.final_summary: I created the note copy_bold_pig.txt in Markor, pasted the clipboard content into it, and saved it. Reopening the file shows the saved text is still there.

steps.note: Launch Markor and inspect its main screen
Tap Create a new file or folder FAB and choose new note
Set name field and extension to .txt
Set extension to .txt and confirm the dialog
Tap OK to create copy_bold_pig.txt and open the editor
Focus the editor and invoke paste (long press for the context menu)
Long press in editor to open the Paste context menu
Tap Paste and read the resulting note content
Tap Save, then go back and verify the file exists
Back to file list and verify copy_bold_pig.txt is listed
Back again to reach the Files list
Reopen copy_bold_pig.txt to confirm saved content
Confirm the note body shows the pasted text
